attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Target Changed
attributes.description: Detects changes to a recovery or restore target that may alter where protected data is recovered.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects changes to a recovery or restore target that may alter where protected data is recovered.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
)
and (
  message:*target*
  or message:*destination*
)
and (
  message:*changed*
  or message:*updated*
  or message:*modified*
)
